division: Andaman and Nicobar - North & Middle Andaman

name: Andaman & Nicobar State Data Centre (ANSDC), Port Blair
developer: Andaman & Nicobar Administration / SOVTECH / National e-Governance Plan
notes: State Data Centre at/near DBRAIT campus, Dollygunj, Port Blair; government/NIC and procurement documents identify ANSDC as a core e-governance infrastructure project. No public IT-load capacity found.

name: Google/Raiden Infotech AI Hub - Rambilli/Anakapalli campus cluster
developer: Google / Raiden Infotech India, with AdaniConneX and Nxtra by Airtel
notes: Google announced/broke ground on India's first gigawatt-scale AI hub with three data center campuses; reporting and land-allotment coverage place part of the cluster at Rambilli in Anakapalli district, alongside Visakhapatnam sites.

name: CtrlS Rambilli hyperscale data center
notes: Andhra Pradesh land allocation reported for 49.93 acres at APIIC Industrial Park, Rambilli, Anakapalle district, for a 100 MW data center with about Rs 2,788.3 crore investment.

name: TCS HyperVault / proposed OpenAI AI data center campus, Anakapalli
developer: Tata Consultancy Services / HyperVault; OpenAI reported as prospective anchor customer
notes: Trade press reports TCS secured 200 acres in Anakapalli for AI data centre expansion; site reportedly tied to OpenAI's first India data centre, starting around 100 MW and scalable to 1 GW. Specific site use not officially confirmed by TCS/OpenAI.

name: National Hydrology Project district data center building, Chittoor
developer: Andhra Pradesh Water Resources Department / National Hydrology Project
notes: Tender aggregator lists construction of a district data center building for surface water and ground water audit department in Chittoor under the National Hydrology Project; no hyperscale/commercial data center evidence found.
